events.result:
Batch 3 migrated, 40 records (120 migrated so far).
Validation note: the old CRM stored phone numbers without country codes. The new CRM
assumed every number was domestic and saved it with a +1 prefix. 31 of the 120
records migrated so far belong to overseas customers, so their phone numbers in the
new CRM are wrong. Records from batches 4 to 10 will have the same problem.
New CRM activity: 14 sales users have opened customer records in the last 24 hours.

args.body: Migration paused after batch 3: 120/400 records migrated; 280 remain untouched. Validation found the new CRM automatically added +1 to phone numbers lacking country codes, leaving 31 overseas customers’ numbers incorrect across batches 1–3. Batches 4–10 would have the same issue. The new CRM is live; 14 sales users opened customer records in the past 24 hours, so incorrect numbers may already have been used (specific affected records/users were not provided). No corrections have been made. Please coordinate an immediate warning to sales not to rely on migrated overseas phone numbers, and arrange the affected customer IDs with verified international numbers plus a corrected import process. The available tools cannot retrieve those details or change the import behavior; remaining migration is stopped pending a safe path.
